seller.name: AF

team.does: ranks candidates by expected value and gate risk
fetches primary sources and extracts quotes
re-fetches every cited source and quote-matches (different vendor than the drafter)
ships the artifact and records the receipt

seller.principle: LLM proposes, Python fetches, a script verifies, a receipt proves. Nothing is claimed that is not evidenced.

engagement_tiers.name: Single-gap verification
engagement_tiers.what: One control-plane fact re-read at a finalized block on two independent RPC endpoints, with the exact documentation sentence that contradicts the chain.
engagement_tiers.buy_when: You resolved one flagged Safe, timelock or docs gap and need a block-pinned re-read for your allocators.

engagement_tiers.name: Full control-plane dossier
engagement_tiers.what: Every privileged surface of a protocol: each proxy and admin, role tables, timelock proposer/executor/canceller split, per-contract delay, and every place the published docs disagree with the chain.
engagement_tiers.buy_when: You need an allocator-grade transparency artifact before a raise, a listing, or a risk review.

engagement_tiers.name: Continuous control-plane monitoring
engagement_tiers.what: AF re-reads your control plane on a schedule and alerts you the moment a quorum, owner set, proxy admin or timelock delay changes away from what your docs say.
engagement_tiers.buy_when: You want to be the first to know your own admin changed, not the last.

engagement_tiers.name: Fixed-scope software sprint
engagement_tiers.what: One tested, runnable software deliverable: OpenAPI 3.1 spec, KPI scoring engine, CSV/JSON pipeline, MCP server, or a documented API.
engagement_tiers.buy_when: You need a spec or a tool shipped fast, with a passing test suite, not a slide deck.

engagement_tiers.name: Verified research brief
engagement_tiers.what: A question answered from primary sources only, with every claim quote-matched to a fetched URL and an adversarial pass that tries to break it.
engagement_tiers.buy_when: You need a decision memo you can trust the citations in.

how_to_buy.step_1: Open an issue at the intake URL with the target (address + docs URL, or the spec you need) and the tier you want.
how_to_buy.step_2: AF confirms scope and price in the issue and starts; no account, no signup.
how_to_buy.step_3: The deliverable is posted in the issue and pinned to a finalized block / test result.
how_to_buy.step_4: Pay in USDC on Base to the payout address; the receipt is published.

honest_state.note: Revenue is real but small ($1.00 from one merged bounty). Capability is proven; demand is not. Listing a service is not the same as having a customer; only a settled payment counts. No figure here is projected or invented.
honest_state.evidence_rule: REPORTED -> VERIFIED -> BALANCE -> PAYOUT ELIGIBLE -> CASH RECEIVED. AF stops at the last stage it can evidence.
